articleTitle: Fetal Heart Baseline Extraction And Classification based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: Electronic fetal heart monitoring is a common method to detect fetal abnormalities used by obstetricians. Effective analysis and diagnosis of cardiotocography during labor not only helps to solve the problem of neonatal cerebral palsy caused by fetal distress, but also greatly reduces neonatal mortality. Among the existing analysis algorithms, most of them are based on machine learning to extract and classify the characteristics of cardiotocography. The results which depend on the recognition of features are always unstable. The baseline of fetal heart rate is the most basic characteristic. In this paper, the baseline characteristics of fetal heart rate are firstly extracted, and then the Long Short-Term Memory network is used for segmental classification of fetal heart rate. The results of the experiment show the superiority and efficiency of deep learning in feature extraction, and make it possible for fetal distress detection in computer-aid diagnosis which has greatly reduced the burden on doctors.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Sea Unmanned Ship Routing Protocol Based on Ad Hoc Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: With the development of society, maritime communication system will affect the future military and civil needs directly. There are a lot of natural resources in the ocean, and some areas have important strategic value. The exploration and development of the ocean will be the focus of future research. The growing scale of research and the lack of offshore infrastructure also put forward severe requirements for future maritime communications. Based on the research of unmanned exploration vessels on the sea, this paper draws on the technical characteristics of wireless Ad Hoc networks to build a sea-based unmanned ship network system. Through simulation, we can see the advantages of ad hoc network in ship networking. In the absence of infrastructure, messages can be transmitted to each other to achieve interoperability.

articleTitle: Finger vein recognition algorithm based on improved weighted sparse representation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: For single-features based on finger vein image texture features (LBP), image gradient features (HOG), and other features with poor image contrast, the feature extraction effect is not ideal, and the sparse representation classification method based on residual size classification is used in low-quality images. This paper proposes a method for finger vein recognition based on improved weighted sparse representation. In order to reduce the heterogeneity of the samples participating in sparse reconstruction, this paper weights each training sample based on the sum of existing sparse coefficients as a classification basis to reduce the heterogeneity of samples participating in sparse reconstruction. On this basis, this paper uses the sum of intra-class coefficients instead of reconstruction errors as the basis for classification judgment. It has a high recognition rate for finger vein images with poor contrast.

articleTitle: Deforestation Prediction Using Time Series and LSTM
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: Wildfires and deforestation are dragging the Amazon rainforests into a disaster, an irreversible cycle of collapse. The speed of deforestation must be calculated, aided by advanced technologies in an effort to save these rainforests. The paper proposed two AI techniques, namely Time Series and LSTM, which were used to predict the future deforestation of Amazon rainforests. The calculations revealed an urgent need to take action to prevent further deterioration. It is believed that the assistance of the advanced AI techniques will efficiently slow down deforestation, thus improving the environment in the foreseeable future.

articleTitle: The application of artificial intelligence in the internet of things
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: At present, the concepts of artificial intelligence (AI) and robots are widely known by people and artificial intelligence brings great convenience for people's life and study. With the progress of science and technology, artificial intelligence has become a popular development trend. At the same time, internet is also gradually publicized, which drives the rapid development of all walks of life. Under this situation, the internet of things is born and its driving role in China's economic development is continuously highlighted, which promotes the effective development of Chinese economy. In the essay, the comprehensive studies are conducted based on the different application scenarios of artificial intelligence in the internet of things, like autonomous vehicles, smart home, computer network, robot and so on, and its application prospect is discussed.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Microservice Application Automation Testing Framework
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: Microservice style breaks through the traditional monolithic application into a new generation of distributed architecture, which realizes agile development and deployment. How to ensure its quality and reliability by testing technology is the focus in the software engineering. According to the characteristics of microservice application, this paper analyzes the test objects and test procedure, proposes an automation testing framework based on modularization and data-driven, and illustrates the main functions and processes of each layer. Furthermore, a data structure based on the extended interface description file is designed so as to generate test case data automatically. This framework will contribute to establishing the microservice testing platform and standard for SGCC (State Grid Corporation of China), which is able to improve the enterprise testing capability, raise work efficiency and achieve effective management.

articleTitle: Feasibility analysis of network security teaching platform based on KVM and GNS3
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, the social demand for network security talents is increasingly prominent. In view of this situation, colleges and universities began to gradually expand the training of network security talents, but there are more difficulties and resistance. In this paper, we analyze the feasibility of building a network security teaching platform based on KVM and GNS3, so as to solve the problems existing in the network security teaching process of colleges and universities, such as the high cost of hardware and software, as well as the difficulties in practice.

articleTitle: Robust self-localization system based on multi-sensor information fusion in city environments
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: Recently, autonomous vehicle of self-localization based on the high definition (HD) map become more popular due to the availability of HD map and the dropping prices of LIDAR. Many types of studies have improved the local and global accuracy of HD map for accurate localization. However, the global accuracy of a map does not guarantee the accurate self-localization within the map. In this paper, by investigating the scene errors in the map and comparing their characteristics, we introduced four factors that affect the self-localization ability of the map. These factors are highly related to the environment, namely feature sufficiency, layout, local similarity, and representation quality of the map. Then, in order to overcome the limitations brought by the map itself, we proposed a multi-sensor information fusion self-localization system. The system uses GNSS, LIDAR, IMU, and local map to fuse multi-source information. Global mapping is not required for autonomous vehicle's accurate self-localization. To achieve a high precision of global positioning, the system uses Kalman filter to integrate GNSS positioning, slam and inertial navigation solution to improve the robustness of the system, and the method of local map matching is used to eliminate the accumulated error and modify the positioning system. By conducting the experiments in a typical testing environment, we have evaluated the performance of this system by comparing the ground truth with the self-localization error.

articleTitle: High dynamic range infrared image compression and denoising
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: Detail enhancement and noise removal are major issues in high dynamic range (HDR) infrared image processing. The main focus is how to effectively compress the high dynamic range infrared image to display on the low dynamic range monitors, and in this compression process, both the image details can be enhanced and the noises can be removed. In this paper, we propose a new method to achieve high dynamic range infrared image compression. In the proposed framework, the Laplace differential and Histogram projection are respectively used to sharpen and compress the raw image. Because the image details and noises are enhanced, we design a denoising deep convolutional neural network (DnDCNN)to remove the noises of the image processed in the previous step. By training an additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN) model with different noise levels, our model is capable of processing Gaussian noise at unknown noise levels. Specifically, residual learning and skip connection strategy are utilized to speed up the training process as well as boost the denoising performance. Final extensive experiments demonstrate that our CNN model is very effective in removing such infrared image noise, and the output image has excellent visualization effect.

articleTitle: Gradient-based Interpretation on Convolutional Neural Network for Classification of Pathological Images
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: Digital pathological images have been developing very fast with the recent progress in imaging hardware. It provides tons of imaging data for diagnostic purposes in medical applications. Data-driven algorithms, especially convolutional neural networks (CNN), have been successfully applied in various image analysis tasks. However, neural network models are regarded as black box model and they are supposed to be more interpretable and transparent for real-life applications, especially in the field of medical image analysis. In this work, we trained a CNN model on digital pathological images from lymph nodes sections to classify metastatic tissue, achieving F1 score of over 86%. Furthermore, we investigate the possible ways to understand how the model makes decisions using gradient-based method.

articleTitle: On the Maximum Unambiguous Range of LFMCW Radar
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: The unambiguous range of a radar is the maximum range at which a target can be located so as to guarantee that the reflected signal/pulse from that target corresponds to the most recent transmitted pulse. It is an important factor for radar. Different modulation patterns of Linear Frequency Modulator Continuous Wave (LFMCW) have different maximum unambiguous range. For an easy way to calculate the factor, Single Period Ambiguity Function (SPAF) is proposed to analyze the unambiguous range of LFMCW radar. The receiver of a LFMCW radar can be analysed with SPAF. By analyzing cuts of SPAF along small Doppler shifts of symmetrical sawtooth LFMCW radar, it is demonstrated that its maximum unambiguous range will correspond to the shift equal to half of the modulation period. And the maximum unambiguous range of arbitrary LFMCW radar is αT (T is the period, and α is the symmetrical factor, 0<α≤1). With this result, it is easy and intuitional to calculate the maximum unambiguous range of LFMCW radar.

Author Keywords: Linear Frequency Modulator Continuous Wave Radar

articleTitle: The Research of Dynamic Encryption & Decryption Methods Based on the Binary Random Hash
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: This paper proposes a new method of encryption and decryption based on stream cipher. The method completely abandoned the traditional mathematical calculation method. Its main principle is to using the key to get a binary random Hash mapping; the plaintext will be evenly dispersed in a known binary random Hash, and then mapped to the cipher space. This encryption method has a very strong randomness and collision resistance. The algorithm analysis shows that the time and space complexity of the method is the same as the traditional stream cipher algorithm, both of which are o (n). Finally, we test the time efficiency of the method, and the experimental results show that block and multithreading technology will greatly improve the encryption efficiency for large files.

articleTitle: Study on the application of intelligent optimization algorithm in the optimization of passive positioning network layout
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: With the development of intelligent optimization algorithms, more and more optimization algorithms are applied to solve the optimization problems in real production and life. In a certain background environment, the positioning accuracy of the multi-station passive positioning system largely depends on the specific distribution of the stations in the system. Therefore, by analyzing the constraint conditions and reasonably establishing the model, the optimization problem of passive positioning network distribution station can be transformed into an optimization problem and solved by intelligent optimization algorithm. The GDOP direction finding cross location algorithm formula was deduced, the analysis is established under the condition of certain multistation disposition optimization model of passive location system is proposed using genetic algorithm and particle swarm optimization (pso), artificial fish algorithm of embattling method for solving optimization problem, through the comparison and analysis it is concluded that the particle swarm algorithm is more suitable for more rapid network cloth station station passive location system.

articleTitle: A Secure Dynamic Authorization Model Based on Improved CapBAC
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: The emergence of new concepts of Internet of Things and Resource Sharing has brought great convenience to modern life, at the same time, it also brings much more privacy and security issues. The authorization of IoT equipment is one of the most difficult and hot issues. In this paper, we propose a secure dynamic authorization model and realize 1) flexible authorization by designing a time-sharing authorization algorithm based on time slice and 2) safe and dynamic authorization by introducing JWT authentication technology to CapBAC model. Experiments on real intelligent parking platform show that the proposed model in this paper can bring up to 50% growth in average utilization of the parking system.

articleTitle: Application and research of GIS intelligent environmental protection Internet of things system construction technology
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: the wisdom of this project is based on GIS environmental iot system building technical application and research, is the use of geographic space information technology, satellite remote sensing technology, global satellite positioning technology, radio frequency identification technology, based on the electronic map, image data, which is based on Internet, metropolitan area network, or LAN, in different spatial location of environmentally friendly iot devices intuitive visual control, intelligent identification, location and tracking, monitoring, alarm, inspection and maintenance of various environmental iot information flow, gathering and processing and statistical analysis, system management and comprehensive application of socialized service system. This project studies the application of the GIS based intelligent environmental protection Internet of things system platform with universal applicability, realizing the unified access, storage, exchange, analysis and application framework of environmental perception information, and establishing the data center of the platform. The system of "digital environmental protection" has been constructed, and the Internet of things and sensor network in the field of environmental protection have been gradually constructed to promote the transformation from "digital environmental protection" to "smart environmental protection" and "digital city" to "smart city", thus revolutionizing the improvement of urban management level.

articleTitle: Optimal Weapon Target Assignment based on Improved QPSO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: An improved quantum-behaved particle swarm optimization algorithm (QPSO) algorithm is presented to solve the optimal weapon target assignment problem for surface-to-air missile systems in this paper. The optimal weapon target assignment problem for surface-to-air missile system is a nonlinear and NP-hard optimal programming problem which is hard to be solved by traditional optimization algorithm. The improved QPSO algorithm is a hybrid optimization algorithm which combines the basic PSO algorithm, crossover-mutation operator and quantum-behaved to avoid getting into local solution. Numerical experiment for the optimal weapon target assignment problem shows the effectiveness of the improved QPSO algorithm.

articleTitle: Multi-Authority Attribute-Based Encryption for Resource-Constrained Users in Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: Multi-authority attribute-based encryption (MA-ABE) is a promising technique to protect data privacy and achieve fine-grained access control in edge computing for Internet of Things (IoT). However, most of the existing MA-ABE schemes suffer from expensive computational cost in the encryption and decryption phases, which are not practical for resource constrained users in IoT. We propose a large-universe MA-CP-ABE scheme with online/offline encryption and outsourced decryption. In our scheme, most expensive encryption operations have been executed in the user's initialization phase by adding reusable ciphertext pool besides splitting the encryption algorithm to online encryption and offline encryption. Moreover, massive decryption operation are outsourced to the near edge server for reducing the computation overhead of decryption. The proposed scheme is proven statically secure under the q-DPBDHE2 assumption. The performance analysis results indicate that the proposed scheme is efficient and suitable for resource-constrained users in edge computing for IoT.

articleTitle: Taxi Scheduling Optimization with Incomplete Information
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: Past researches on taxi operation mainly tackles the problem of taxi scheduling from an economics and mathematical modeling perspective. Such methodology requires as much information as possible to yield accurate and meaningful results. However, such information is usually impossible to get as data are becoming crucial assets to taxi companies. In this study we propose a novel model and simulation of taxi scheduling where limited and incomplete information is given. We aim to reduce the waiting time for taxi driver by generating cruising strategy for them. Our simulation strategy turns out to reduce taxi waiting time by 7% which has potential economic improvement.

articleTitle: The application of deep learning on fast skin cancer diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: Nowadays, health problems have been more and more important. In order to solve the difficulties of diagnosing skin cancer quickly and precisely, we applied a state-of-the-art deep convolutional neural network (CNN) architecture with transfer learning, to help diagnose various types of skin cancers. Combined with proper data augmentation and normalization, the designed model achieves state-of-the-art result, including f1-score to be as high as 0.83, which demonstrates a promising application of the deep neural network on visual diagnosis of skin illness.

articleTitle: Based on the Internet of things environment data aggregation security requirements and key technology research
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: With the increase of the scale of sensor nodes in the Internet of things, a large amount of data is generated in the network. Processing and transferring this data consumes a lot of communication, energy, computing and storage resources. Due to the limited resources (energy, computing power and storage capacity) of sensor nodes, how to effectively deal with the large amount of data generated in the Internet of things has become an urgent problem to be solved. Aiming at the energy consumption, environment and security of wireless sensor networks, data aggregation technology is proposed. In this context, data aggregation came into being. Due to the aggregation of multiple data into one data in the process of data transmission, data aggregation reduces data redundancy, saves energy consumption, bandwidth and other resources, thus reducing data transmission delay and thereby improving the reliability, security and stability of the network. This increases the network life cycle. The security of data aggregation in the Internet of things is effectively solved.

articleTitle: Food Transaction Scheme Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: In the traditional food transaction, there are many problems, such as lack of trust between customers and businesses, and the information of food trade is easy to be tampered with. Therefore, this paper applies the blockchain technology to the traditional food transaction and proposes a food transaction scheme based on blockchain technology, combining with the problems existing in the actual transaction. This scheme includes two stages, namely, user information collection stage and the food transaction stage. This scheme also uses the orderly aggregation signature to ensure the authenticity and reliability of the transaction. First of all, in the user information collection stage, the food safety system will process the user information with cryptography, so that the information can be stored in the blockchain safely and efficiently. Next, in the food transaction stage, the initiator and the receiver of the food transaction will sign the transaction information released by themselves; then, the information will be verified to be effective enough that can be uploaded to the blockchain network. Finally, in terms of security, the scheme can resist password attacks, distributed attacks, and other network attacks.

articleTitle: Time synchronization scheme based on broadcast gossip algorithm for wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: A time synchronization algorithm based on broadcast gossip algorithm for wireless sensor networks was proposed to realize synchronization improvement by combining the broadcasting characteristics of wireless channel and gossip algorithm. The passage introduces the pairwise gossip algorithm and broadcast gossip algorithm, and compares them. It introduces the time synchronization algorithm based on broadcast gossip in detail and analyzes its convergence and performance. Finally, we simulate it and confirm the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm in expediting the convergence rate and reducing the energy consumption.

articleTitle: Estimation and Correction of I/Q Imbalance in Wideband Zero-IF Receiver
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: In this paper, a time domain compensation method is proposed for in-phase (I)/quadrature (Q) mismatch occurring in a wideband Zero-IF radio architecture. First, training sequences are used for error estimation and the FIR filter are developed to reduce the imbalance between the IQ paths. Then, we perform channel equalization on the signal to solve the channel distortion still in the passband. The simulation results of the point-frequency continuous wave (CW) signal and the Radar Chirp signals (LFM) prove the effectiveness of the method. We have established a receiver system level hardware implement platform to test the practicality of the method. The test results show that the method can reduce the IRR by about 29dB.

articleTitle: A two-dimensional material recognition image algorithm based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: The Van der Waals heterojunction is composed of stacked atomically thin two-dimensional materials. As a new type material, it has many unprecedented characteristics. However, owing to the position and shape of the two-dimensional material peeling are random during the preparation process, the preparation efficiency of Van der Waals heterojunction is always low. Finding the peeled two-dimensional material quickly has become the key to improve the preparation speed of Van der Waals heterojunctions. In recent years, deep learning has become more and more excellent in the field of image recognition, and the application of deep learning on two-dimensional material recognition has achieved a very good effect. In this paper, we use deep learning-based semantic segmentation network to identify and segment two-dimensional materials in images collected under optical microscope. Moreover, the network architecture was improved to achieve an average accuracy of 97.17%. Since deep learning algorithms can extract high-level features of images through training with a large amount of data, compared with traditional graphics algorithms, the deep learning algorithm have good generalization capabilities and are robust to changes in conditions during detection, which can avoid errors caused by traditional algorithms that require manual adjustment of parameters.

articleTitle: Computer-aided Pathological Annotation Framework: A Deep Learning-Based Diagnostic Algorithm of Lung Cancer
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: Whole-slide image (WSI) annotation is fundamental to computational pathology. However, pixel-level manual annotation of large-scale histopathology dataset is impractical due to the combination of required labor-intensitive tasks and the budget limitation in pathologists' supports. In this paper, we develop a framework for computer-aided annotation of cancerous region on WSI with pathologically conformed lung cancers aiming to significantly reduce the workload of pathologists in annotation on the WSIs. We used deep convolutional neural network (DCNN) to automate the labeling of the area of cancerous lesions. Our method was able to identify malignant area on tested WSIs with a mean dice of 0.84, in comparison to pathologists' manual annotation.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Intelligent Irrigation Things Cloud System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: The things-oriented cloud system of intelligent irrigation contains modern information technologies, such as Internet, cloud computing, big data and mobile applications [1]. The intelligent irrigation system focusing on the integrated management services for agricultural irrigation, is invented by collecting and analyzing information related to irrigation, such as soil moisture content, meteorological elements and crop growth, combines with the experiences of agricultural experts and agricultural technical information and forming mathematical models and schemes through computer languages. The design of the intelligent irrigation cloud system was completed through the overall framework design of the system, the design of the basic data platform system and the multi-stage application subsystem. The system consists of a primary system and multiple application subsystems and can be dynamically combined and extended. It realizes the information monitoring of soil, weather and crop growth factors, the management and optimization of water and fertilizer models, the recommendation of irrigation schemes, and the comprehensive service of intelligent irrigation.

articleTitle: Design and Usability of the Touch-based Interface of CNC Presses
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: Usability problem refers to the difficulty in the user-centered interface design of industrial computer numerical control (CNC) presses. In the industrial field, the development of touch-based interface design satisfies the functional requirements, but ignores the user-centered design concept. This study develops a touch interactive interface of CNC presses to improve its usability, and the application of usability theory in industrial numerical control. Usability correlation theory is used to conduct the usability experiment of the designed interactive interface of CNC presses. The usability of the interface is studied by combining Eye-tracking experiment and Questionnaire. Results show that a reasonable and effective usability assessment can help designers solve practical problems and obtain the best solution. The usability assessment system of the touch interface of CNC equipment is proposed, and the usability assessment methods commonly used in the actual development process are summarized. Efforts are made to provide design guidance for the usability evaluation of similar interfaces.

articleTitle: A two-level stacking model for detecting abnormal users in Wechat activities
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: Machine learning algorithms are widely employed in plenty of classification or regression problems. While in real business world, it is confronted with huge and disorder data pattern. To recognize different kinds of users on the internet accurately and fast becomes a challenge. In a Wechat online bargain activity, the staff found that some strange users are highly like robots or malicious users. Thus we tried a two-level stacking model to detect them. This design got a good result of 0.98 accuracy after the training phase and an accuracy of 0.90 in a new term of the testing set. Moreover, this model is adaptable to linear and nonlinear datasets because of its diverse stacking of first-level classifiers. Therefore, this paper indicates a potential of the stacking classification model in big data times.

articleTitle: Sparse Visual Localization in GPS-Denied Indoor Environments
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: This paper presents a real time feature based sparse visual localization algorithm for indoor environments such as shopping mall. ORB feature is used for feature detection and descriptor computation in this project. The features extracted from ORB are mainly points in corners, and edges. Since this project is used for indoor localization, the dataset for experiment is TUM RGBD dataset. This dataset contains various indoor environments which can fulfill our requirements. The essential and fundamental matrices are solved based on the matching of ORB features and Eight-point algorithm. We show certain advantages of sparse visual localization algorithms in our experiment's results.

articleTitle: A Scheme of Combining Differential Chaos Shift Keying with Multiple-Input Multiple-Output System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: Applying chaotic digital communication system on wireless channel is a very difficult problem to solve. A new scheme based on Multiple Input Multiple Output (MIMO) system is proposed aiming at improving Bit Error Rate (BER) in chaotic communication. Incorporating Differential Chaos Shift Keying (DCSK) with MIMO could improve the transmission efficiency of chaotic secure communication scheme. Moreover, embedding the DCSK algorithm in the MIMO system could meet the demand of security and transmission efficiency. In addition, making simulation of this algorithm and getting the bit error rate analysis chart could let us know the performance of communication. Testing results show the accuracy and rationality of MIMO-DCSK system, but further study is needed in terms of scalable scheme.

articleTitle: Optimization Method of OFDM Shared Signal Frequency Resource Based on Complexity of Electromagnetic Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: Aiming at the typical OFDM shared signal, a method of frequency resource optimization based on the complexity of electromagnetic environment is proposed. Firstly, the mathematical model of multi-dimensional electromagnetic environment occupancy in time domain, spatial domain and frequency domain is given. Based on the above model, a method of adaptive allocation of sub-carriers in different frequency bands is given. It has a pioneering significance in the optimization of integrated frequency resources of radar communication and jamming.

articleTitle: Design of Traffic Coordination Control Structure Based on Multi-Agent
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: Urban transport, one of the city's important infrastructures, which plays an important role in the normal functioning of the city, has become the focus of attention and discussion in the whole society. Restricting to the sustainable development of urban economy, the traditional solution to the urban traffic problems can no longer meet the development requirements of existing urban traffic. Given the complexity of urban transport, the limitations of traditional traffic control methods and the popularization and application of mature artificial intelligence technology, this paper discusses the collaborative framework of traffic control and induction on the base of multi-Agent technology and make researches on the structural design of urban traffic coordination control, thus building a simulation model for the single intersection. The simulation experiment was carried out by using the Q learning algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on the Communication Path of New Media and Traditional Culture Based on Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: Chinese excellent traditional culture is pregnant with rich ideological and moral resources and is fertile soil for cultivating and promoting socialist core values. The development of information technology and the popularization of computers have turned Chinese culture into a weak force in the world cultural community. In the new media era, the overall optimization of traditional cultural transmission channels is conducive to the inheritance of Chinese civilization, enriching the connotation of traditional culture, promoting national culture, enhancing the spiritual and cultural strength of the people, and shaping the good cultural accomplishment of the people. With the vigorous development of new media under information technology, it is an effective way to spread Chinese excellent traditional culture to explore how to make full use of the characteristics of new media that everyone can carry out mass communication, give full play to the advantages of the initiative of new media audience groups, and avoid the negative effects brought by the disadvantages of new media to the greatest extent.

articleTitle: Research on network and information security in Colleges and Universities
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: With the advancement and development of information technology in Colleges and universities, campus network plays a more and more important role in Colleges and universities, and gradually becomes an important infrastructure for teaching, scientific research, management, and foreign exchange and cooperation. However, how to ensure the campus network security has become the most important problem in the construction and development of university informatization. In view of the problems existing in the current campus network and information security, this paper makes an in-depth discussion and analysis from the aspects of network technology means and security prevention strategies, and puts forward the preventive measures and suggestions for the network and information security problems in Colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Design of Simulation system Based Double 2-vote-2 Computer-based Interlocking System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: Based on the TYJL_III type double 2-vote-2 safety redundant computer-based interlocking system and referring to the existing mature computer technology and communication interface technology, a simulation system is designed and developed, which can simulate not only the interlocking input and output subsystem, but also other signal safety control equipment such as the train control center(TCC) and the radio block center(RBC) and so on. In this paper, the system structure, system characteristics, software and hardware design principles of the simulation system are introduced in detail.

articleTitle: Design of ecological environment monitoring platform for substituting small hydropower for fuel area
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: Based on the current situation and urgent needs of China's substituting small hydropower for fuel engineering ecological environment, a small-scale substituting hydropower for fuel engineering ecological environment monitoring platform based on wireless sensor network was designed and proposed. Focus on real-time dynamic acquisition of eco-environment parameters of sensor nodes integrating water quality sensors, soil sensors and gas sensors on the on-site inspection platform. The ZigBee technology is used in close proximity, and the GPRS wireless communication technology is used to realize the establishment and data transmission of the sensor network. The system effectively improves the convenience and reliability of the ecological environment monitoring of substituting small hydropower for fuel engineering.

articleTitle: Ultraviolet light emitting diode intelligent control system
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: Ultraviolet light emitting diode (UVLED) is a new curing method that can be applied to the printing industry. It can save more than 80% energy compared with the traditional curing method. The traditional Proportion Integration Differentiation. (PID) control method is generally adopted for the control method of UVLED. However, compared with the actual production demand, the intelligent control method is becoming more and more popular. This paper designs the UVLED control system, which is mixed in series and parallel, and uses the single-pole active power factor correction (APFC) converter to design the online adjustment in the discontinuous mode. Flyback constant current drive power supply. Through comparison and analysis of different heat dissipation methods, the Light Emitting Diode (LED) chip adopts a flip-chip structure, and the outer surface is encapsulated by a hemispherical epoxy resin, and the maximum exiting light angle is 45 degrees, and a baffled parallel flow path is adopted. Finally, the control method is upgraded by particle swarm optimization (PSO), and the simulation results can reach the ideal control condition.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Bayesian and E-Bayesian Statistical Inference of Reliability of Geometric Distribution
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: Geometric distribution is a very important distribution in reliability area. The aim of this paper is to study the estimation problem of reliability of Geometric distribution. Hierarchical Bayesian method is more robust than ordinary Bayesian method. A new Hierarchical Bayesian and E-Bayesian estimation methods are put forward under scaled squared error loss function. First, we develop a new hierarchical prior distribution of reliability of Geometric distribution on the basis of negative logarithm gamma distribution, which can fit all kinds of density functions on the interval (0, 1) when changing values of it's parameters. Then we derive hierarchical Bayesian and E-Bayesian estimators under scaled squared error loss function. Finally, Monte Carlo simulations prove that the hierarchical Bayesian estimation is more robust than E-Bayeisan estimation.

articleTitle: Research on the Antecedents of Users' Innovative Use of IT Based on the Work Competence Theory
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: Users' behavior is a key effect factor of successful application of IT. However, extant research has focused on the in-role behaviors such as IT adoption and routine IT usage, while the research on users' innovative use of IT which belongs to extra-role behaviors is still limited. Based on the research gap of innovative use of IT at the individual level and work competence theory, this paper analyzed the antecedents of innovative use of IT. Hypotheses are proposed and tested with the data collected by a survey of 156 ERP users. The results show that attitude towards innovation, IT application knowledge, extraversion, and management support have important effects on innovative use of IT at the individual level. Implications of the research results are discussed.

articleTitle: Exploring the Cultivation Mechanism of Four Innovations and Innovative Entrepreneurs
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: In accordance with the development needs of various aspects of China's economic society, the theoretical research and practice of innovation and entrepreneurship education have been in full swing in recent years. The article summarizes the current research status of innovation and entrepreneurship education in China from three dimensions: connotative value, model, and development path. It considers that innovation and entrepreneurship education is rich in content and aims to cultivate students' innovative entrepreneurship, thinking, spirit, and ability. It is of great significance to promote the reform of college education and to promote college students to adapt to social and economic development.

articleTitle: Analysis of ciliary beat frequency in the mouse oviduct using optical coherence tomography
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: Oviduct, along with the ciliary beat at a native frequency, plays a key role in gamete transport, fertilization and preimplantation embryo development in mammals. However, it remains largely unclear about the mechanism of reproductive medicine accompanied by the cilia activity. Therefore, this study aimed to explore the ciliary motion using our custom-designed spectral domain optical coherence tomography (SD-OCT) system with the central wavelength of 840 nm. Typically, OCT allows for mapping the cilia locations in mouse oviduct in vivo with the high-speed micro-scale resolution. Prior to the experiment, the OCT imaging was compared with the digital microscopic imaging, so as to validate our approaches and algorithms for measuring cilia in mouse trachea in vitro. The results demonstrated that, the OCT system not only rapidly determined the ciliary beat frequency (CBF) in the mouse oviduct in vivo, but also presented the mapping of CBF in the mouse oviduct. Furthermore, the ciliary motion was analyzed by selecting four areas of interest from the mapping of CBF location. The results suggested that, ciliary beat showed a similar frequency range within a local region in identical mouse oviduct fold. In conclusion, the approach proposed in this study benefits the in vivo study on mammalian reproduction, which contributes to exploring the link of infertility and ciliary activities.

articleTitle: The Visual Analysis of Certificate System of Vocational Education Based on CiteSpace
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: This paper uses the method of econometric analysis to visually analyze the research literature of China's certificate system in the past 30 years based on CiteSpace and other software. Through key words analysis, social network analysis and graph cluster analysis, this paper obtains 10 research clusters of China's certificate system. And the current situation of the research on the certificate system in China is obtained, such as the lack of in-depth study.

articleTitle: Quality of Services Multicast Routing Presented by Using Intelligent Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: With the rapid developments of Internet, mobile networks as well as high-performance networking technology, quality-of-service (QoS) of multicast routing has become a very important research issue in the areas of networks and distributed systems. Quality of services multicast routing main objective to construct a multicast tree that optimized a multi objective function with respect to performance-related constraints (Short path, delay, packet loss). The proposed algorithm was divided in two steps: Firstly, the multicast tree selection algorithm was based on shortest path; Secondly, to find routes with two or more QoS parameters, it will divide into two parts according to the customer service. Part one optimizes QoS based on delay minimization and packet loss. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm was an effective approach to multicast routing decision with multiple QoS constrains for mobile ad-hoc networks .

articleTitle: Research on the Performance Test Method of Information System Based on the Domestic Software and Hardware Platform
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: In order to more accurately evaluate the requirement-meeting situation and scalability of performance index of the information system based on the domestic software and hardware platform, this paper proposes a performance test method that integrates performance, margin, capacity and strength tests. The test result shows that the method is of guiding significance for evaluating the performance index of the system and exploring its boundary strength.

articleTitle: Resource Allocation Algorithm based on MultiDimensional Resource Description in Complex Optical Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: This paper analyzes the current situation of resource scheduling algorithms in optical networks. Based on the existing problems of resource scheduling in simple networks, complex networks and multi domain networks, the multi-dimensional resource description algorithm is proposed. Based on the description of the algorithm, in order to improve the efficiency of resource scheduling, EA_MOPRWA algorithm is proposed. Aiming at the specific network problems, the simulation shows that the performance of algorithms is improved obviously.

articleTitle: A Novel Triangular Fuzzy Numbers-based Efficacy Coefficient Evaluation Method of English Language Teaching
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: For the fuzziness and uncertainty of performance evaluation of English Language teaching, crisp number is not suitable to express the fuzzy nature of evaluation attributes. Linguistic terms are often used to provide the evaluation values in similar above-mentioned decision-making problems. This paper develops a novel evaluation method for the evaluation of English language teaching with the help of triangular fuzzy numbers for substituting linguistic terms, because the calculation of linguistic terms is usually complex. A new method of performance evaluation is proposed for English language teaching. Finally, a numerical example for evaluating English language teaching is given to illustrate demonstrate the feasibility and practicability of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Construction of Examination Business Management System Based on Identity Matching
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: According to the national policy guidance and practical application, this paper proposes the necessity of constructing a test business management system based on identity matching. It is found that the existing examination business system can not meet the needs of school development. Then it introduces the non-inductive check-in technology, identity matching technology and encryption protection technology to be used in the examination business management system, and uses these key technologies to build the examination business management system based on identity matching, and explains the operation mode of the system. Finally, it summarizes the whole paper and discusses the research direction of the following research group.

articleTitle: A Range Expansion Based Utility Optimization Algorithm for Ultra Dense HetWNets
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: Aiming at the energy waste and co-channel interfere problem caused by the working small cells with sparse users under the scenario of ultra-dense heterogeneous wireless networks (HetWNets), in this paper, an energy saving algorithm with fast convergence is proposed by optimizing user association through cell range expansion and switching off rare-user small cells. Simulated Annealing is employed in combination with the Gibbs Sampling to get the optimal solution of the user association and switch judgment, which finally improves the energy utilization of the wireless network. Simulations show that searching for and switching off serviceless small cells for users can greatly improve the overall energy utility of small cells and improve the overall throughput of the system to a certain extent. By combining Gibbs Sampling with Simulated Annealing, the convergence speed of the optimal solution can be improved. The proposed energy-saving algorithm can effectively improve the energy utility of the system and reduce the complexity of computing in the cloud.

articleTitle: Characterize the noise in PMT based optical imaging system
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: We described a general signal & noise model for optical imaging systems using PMT (photomultiplier tube) as the photo-detector. Based on this model, we proposed a simple method to test if the system is shot-noise limited and if the PMT is working as expected, and we demonstrated it by characterizing the signal to noise ratio in a home-built optical system.

articleTitle: Study on the Construction Specifications of Campus Card in Universities under the New Situation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: This paper introduces the construction specifications of campus card in universities under the new situation of the technology development, including general design requirements, technical standards, card medium selection and design, application systems and application of new technologies. It mainly elaborates the top-level design, user experience, open platform, security system, the intelligent operations, and data analysis, etc., which are applicable to the planning, construction, implementation and operational process of the campus card in universities.

articleTitle: Research on information visualization digital platform of coal mining area based on WebGIS platform
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: Through the information visualization digital platform of coal mining areas based on WebGIS platform, the data informatization and visualization display of major coal mining areas in China have been realized. Combined with geographic information system (GIS), through establishing scientific and rigorous database and platform and setting hierarchical management and access authority, we managed to show the technical and economic indexes and the planning of the main coal mining areas in China, providing a certain research basis for the relevant departments and scientific research units.

articleTitle: Design of filter tow tension balance controller based on C8051F120
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: In order to ensure the tension of the tow into the filter rod forming machine, this paper develops a tow tension balance control system based on C8051F120 high-performance single-chip microcomputer. The system feeds the servo motor speed and tow through the internal driving of the tow. The deflection angle of the tension swing lever is reasonably adjusted to ensure that the tension of the tow entering the filter rod forming machine is in a balanced and stable state. After field installation and debugging, the results show that the controller has reasonable structural design, control logic meets production requirements, and can effectively ensure the balance stability of the tow tension entering the filter rod forming machine.

articleTitle: Operation Command Decision Modeling and Simulation Research Based on Agent Technique
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: Command Decision Simulation (CDS) is an important and difficult issue in the field of simulation. Research on CDS can give support to all kinds of simulation. The thesis studies the practical use of Agent based on technique method in CDS. According to the emphasis on simulation function based on Agent technique method, the essay puts forward the system structure vision of CDS entity and focuses on command decision Agent operation modeling method based on action radix, and also deigns smart algorithm of command decision Agent based on action radix.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Striking Angle of the Towed Linear Array in Torpedo Attack
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: The vertical hit ability is one of the important technical indexes to investigate the torpedo performance, which is closely related to the torpedo's destructive ability. In this paper, the measurement of the striking angle of the towed linear array monitoring torpedo is taken as the research object, which is of great significance to investigate the vertical hit ability of the torpedo.

articleTitle: Software-oriented Test Capability Evaluation Model Design And Implementation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: As we all know, there are a lot of software testing related technologies and tools in the market at this stage, and there are also a lot of professional organizations and organizations working in this field. How to evaluate and measure the software testing capabilities of these tools and organizations has important value. In fact, as the software industry grows, the scale of software will continue to expand, and the resulting consequences are more and even more difficult to find, more deadly software errors. At this point, the correct choice of software testing tools is not only from the consideration of saving development costs, but also directly affects whether the software can be put into normal operation, and whether it needs to spend huge costs in post-maintenance. For a long time, the relevant research on software testing ability evaluation is not perfect. This paper makes the testing ability of software testing tools can be quantitatively evaluated by constructing an evaluation model of software testing capabilities. At the same time, this paper also designs a benchmark test set based on software error injection technology. Through the operation of the benchmark test set on different test tools, the corresponding evaluation indicators can be obtained, and the different test tools are finally compared in the evaluation model. This paper selects several representative test methods currently available on the market. The test set is based on the Siemens Suite. The experimental results show that the performance of these software test methods can be effectively found in accordance with the evaluation system proposed in the paper.

articleTitle: Image Encryption Algorithm Based on Piece Wise Linear Chaotic Map Integration With Linear Diophantine Equation
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: The current chaotic encryption system generally uses a fixed scrambling and diffusion key for encryption, which leads to low efficiency and security. This paper designs a fast image encryption method based on Linear Diophantine equation by constructing a dynamic diffusion mechanism. The coefficients of the Diophantine model are estimated by using the sequence output from the segmented chaotic map, and the Diophantine equation is solved according to the coefficients. A large number of scrambling keys and diffusion keys are generated by the index sorting method, and the scrambling and diffusion of sub images are processed respectively, thus greatly improving the security of the ciphertext. The test data shows that compared with other image encryption schemes, the proposed method has higher security and efficiency, and significantly reduces the time consumption.

articleTitle: Research on Machine Learning Natural Feature Matching Method Based on Statistical Classification
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: With the development of intelligent manufacturing, machine vision has become one of the indispensable technologies in many fields. The so-called machine learning is to acquire images through image sensors, analyze and process the images by computers, and then guide mechanical mechanisms to perform motion operations. As a branch of machine vision, feature matching technology is a key step of many image processing technologies. The matching degree usually directly determines the overall performance of the system. As an important component of artificial intelligence, machine learning has gradually been applied to various industries in recent years. Its intelligent characteristics make the application process achieve substantial results. This article is based on statistical classification methods, combined with the background of natural feature matching in intelligent machine learning and the main matching methods for analysis, and aims to lay the foundation for specific applications in the future.

articleTitle: Data management and application of surface seismic exploration
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: Regularization of surface seismic exploration data has always been a bottleneck problem affecting the progress of data construction. After years of data construction, A1 data management system has accumulated a large number of surface seismic data. However, due to the lack of standardization and integrity of these data, data loading and warehousing and data application efficiency are low, and the availability of seismic data is low. For this reason, the technology of data collection and exchange of surface seismic exploration has been carried out. Starting from the data source of surface seismic exploration, the data normalization process collection of the whole business chain of surface seismic data collection, processing and interpretation has been realized. A set of basic data management process has been established in terms of data quality inspection and other aspects. On this basis, the data collection and delivery test has achieved satisfactory results, forming an advanced process of ground seismic data acceptance and collection and delivery, greatly improving the efficiency of large data normalization delivery. The geophysicists manage and apply the data of surface seismic exploration through the online data collection and exchange system, which improves the working efficiency and verifies the feasibility and practicability of the scheme.

articleTitle: Development and Research of Privacy preserving of data fusion in WSN
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: The energy consumption of wireless sensor network has a direct impact on network lifetime and sensing efficiency, and data fusion technology can perfectly solve this problem. By using the spatial correlation of sensing data between adjacent nodes in the network, the redundant data are fused at the relay nodes, so as to reduce the energy consumption of the network. Considering the demand of data privacy preserving in wireless sensor networks, many data fusion methods with privacy preserving are proposed. This paper analyzes the existing typical privacy preserving data fusion methods, compares their advantages and disadvantages, and puts forward some views on the future research direction.

articleTitle: Visual Analysis of Minsu Research in China Using CiteSpaceV
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: This study uses the CiteSpaceV software to evaluate research progress that has been achieved from 2007 to 2019 on Minsu in China. The number of literature traced in CNKI database is 488. Although the co-author analysis and co-institution show that research network has not formed yet and high-quality researches are inadequate, keywords co-occurrence timeline analysis identifies seven research streams emerged from the literature, including experience and service; sharing economy; rural revitalization; design and renovation; similar accommodation; local culture; and online review analysis. Specifically, the results show that new trends emerge in Minsu researches, which are the research of Airbnb as the trading platform of Minsu in the context of sharing economy, and the research of host-guest interactions and relationships etc. Lastly, research gaps are discussed and suggestions are provided.

articleTitle: Graph-Spectrum Analysis on Shape Relations of Spatial Targets
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: This paper reviews the existing algorithms for extracting the shape features of spatial objects and defines the circumscribed circle of the space targets as the uniform contrast standard of the shape. The object-oriented shape interpolation algorithm is discussed based on mathematical morphology. Based on the existing graph-spectrum, a complete mathematical framework (including complete datum, complete structure, eigenvalue spectral density distribution, etc.) is constructed. According to the selected information granularity, a shape-interpolation method is used to generate a continuously changing sequence of Alpha-shaped sets from the original image to its circumscribed circle, and a positive/inverse spectral density distribution of the shape is generated. Based on the set eigenvalues (such as mean, variance, entropy, and similarity, etc.), the analysis method of the shape Spectrum is described. Finally, an example is given to verify the correctness and feasibility of the method described in this paper.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation and Analysis of Bimorph Pressure Hydrophone Based on ANSYS
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: Inspired by the new bender disc transducer, the bimorph sound pressure hydrophone is designed by changing the upper and lower ceramic discs with the same polarization direction to be connected in series. The natural frequency and mode shape in the air and the admittance curve and sound pressure sensitivity in water are calculated with ANSYS Software. It’s indicated from the results that the working mode of the bimorph sound pressure hydrophone is bending vibration along the thickness direction and the first-order resonant frequency of the bimorph sound pressure hydrophone is about 3600Hz, furthermore, the sensitivity level is about −177.8±0.4dB (0dB=1V/μPa) in the 20~1000Hz and the test result is beyond B&K’s 8104 hydrophone nearly 25dB.

articleTitle: Research and Practice of Customer Satisfaction Evaluation of Railway Equipment Manufacturing Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: Improving customer satisfaction is an effective means to enhance the competitiveness of enterprises. Satisfactory degree of evaluation is seldom carried out in railway enterprises. This paper first studies the method of satisfaction measurement. According to the comparison, the CSI analytic hierarchy process (AHP) and the factor analysis method are used to extract the key factors in many indicators, and the weight distribution is made through the variance contribution rate method, and the satisfaction scores are calculated through the CSI level model. The practice of customer satisfaction evaluation of L group of T group has been carried out. Through the analysis of enterprise status, implementation of questionnaire survey, data analysis and satisfaction calculation, the evaluation work has been completed. Through evaluation, we have grasped the true level of enterprise satisfaction and become an important reference for the development of enterprises. Finally, the evaluation is carried out by multi angle analysis to prove the effectiveness of the satisfaction evaluation.

articleTitle: Chaos Modulation for Optics Secure Communication Based on Parallel Synchronization
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: We study chaos modulation (CM) cryptography for secure communication based on parallel synchronization between a mutually coupled laser system and the other two lasers. Chaotic parallel synchronization and quasi-cycle parallel synchronization are obtained. A novel CM system is discussed while CM decoding is successfully implemented. The result is beneficial to optics secure communications.

articleTitle: Application of BlockChain in the Field of Traditional Chinese Medicine
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: Blockchain is a sort of new Internet technology. As decentralized database technology, it has unique advantages in data management. Traditional Chinese Medicine is the great treasure-house of resources, it has been providing protection for the health of the people for thousands of years. In the past 100 years, modern medicine develops rapidly and the new technology of industrial revolution is applied in the field of medicine. As traditional medicine, Traditional Chinese Medicine faces the test of scientific demonstration in the aspect of sustainable development. If the blockchain technology can be applied in the field of traditional Chinese Medicine, It will improve the statistical reliability of clinical data of Traditional Chinese Medicine, and make it easier to eliminate the false and retain the true, and it will provide data support for the basic medical research and the scientific demonstration of Traditional Chinese Medicine. This paper proposes a conception based on blockchain technology applied in the field of traditional Chinese Medicine. The paper discusses the basic principles of this concept and its systematic architecture. A new system based on my proposal will solve the problems in the practice of Traditional Chinese Medicine.

Author Keywords: Big data of Traditional Chinese Medicine

articleTitle: An overview of antenna reconfiguration technologies : Overview of Reconfigurable Antenna
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: All those antennas who have the ability to show modifications in their frequency, radiation pattern and polarization mode in a reversible and much-controlled way are known as reconfigurable antennas. These are different from other good antennas since their mechanism of reconfiguration is located inside the antenna, and reconfigured in real time according to environmental requirements, so as to adapt to the continuous development and improvement of communication requirements. In this paper, the research status of reconfigurable antennas at home and abroad in recent years is classified and summarized, and examples are given. At the same time, the future development of reconfigurable antenna is analyzed.

articleTitle: Architecture of Spacecraft Control Software Based on Component Perception
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: The basic principle and characteristics of component-based software system were studied. According to the characteristics of spacecraft control software, a construction method of spacecraft control software based on component perception is proposed. A variety of functional and perceptual components based on control requirements are designed. The design method based on concrete software components realization is given, which solves the problem of rapid reconstruction of spacecraft control software effectively with high reusability and reliability.

articleTitle: BIM in the Commercial Real Estate Project Operation and Maintenance Management of Applied Research
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: This paper mainly analyzes the design mode of BIM technology in commercial real estate in the stage of operation and maintenance. The application of lease management, operation management, equipment management, spatial layout analysis and emergency planning business management in the operation and maintenance stage of real estate projects is studied. Through the application of BIM technology, the modern management ideas and methods are adopted to reduce the operating cost of commercial real estate, improve the management level and create more economic value.

articleTitle: Algorithm of Pre-judgment NAF Scalar Multiplication on ECC
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: ECC (Elliptic Curve Cryptography) algorithm is widely used in many field such as smart card due to it's highly security. In some integrated circuits which have poor hardware resource, just like smart card, we need to use a lot of registers to store the temp value of the NAF of k on ECC when we are doing the scalar multiplication. To solve the problem, this paper proposes an algorithm called pre-judgment of NAF base on the general NAF algorithm. It not only inherits the fast computation speed of the general NAF algorithm, and also saves the registers for temp value stored through pre-judge the value of k. It doesn't need to calculate the NAF of k beforehand. It directly calculates the NAF of the k when doing the scalar mutilation in the same state machine. This can help save the hardware resource, and make the low power, low cost IC easy to develop.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Neural Network Based on Cloud Computing in Power Load Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: TIn the process of short-term load forecasting, the non-linear mapping relationship between the factors causing load changes and the load is one of the reasons for the deviation between the predicted results and the actual results. Neural networks have strong nonlinear mapping ability and self-learning ability. In this paper, the distributed idea is introduced, the BP neural network is distributed, and the distributed BP neural network prediction algorithm is implemented on Spark cloud platform. Combined with its advantages in analyzing non-linear problems, we propose a load forecasting model based on neural network, analyze the existing problems of BP algorithm in power load forecasting and make improvements. Starting from the input layer, hidden layer and output layer, a load forecasting model based on neural network is designed and implemented. Taking the daily load data of a certain area as a sample, the collected electric quantity is preprocessed. Then the number of hidden layers and nodes are analyzed and designed. Finally, the short-term daily load is predicted. The comparison results show that the predicted value is in good agreement with the actual value.

articleTitle: Research on health management requirements of information communication system based on SWOT
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: The development analysis model of health management of information communication system is established by using SWOT quantitative analysis method. The internal advantages and disadvantages of health management in information communication system are analyzed. External opportunities and threats are analyzed through SWTO model and a series of data are quantified. According to the quantification results, the quadrilateral diagram and the intensity spectrum coordinate system of the health management development strategy of the information communication system are generated. Finally, some Suggestions on the future development of health management of information communication system are put forward.

articleTitle: Research of the Integration of Humanistic Quality in Education under the Background of Intelligent Big Data
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: In the context of the new era, it is very indispensable to integrate humanistic quality education into college and university. However, there are still some problems because of the impact of big data information, which is not conducive to students' humanity and even affects their future development. The following is an in-depth analysis of the integration of humanistic quality in education under the background of big data information. The purpose of this paper is to effectively promote the integration of humanistic quality between college and university education, in order to improve the humanistic quality of students as well as better development of students.

articleTitle: Propose A novel scheme of Cooperative Networks Based on the Locations of Relays in the Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: A novel scheme of cooperative networks was proposed depending on the number and locations of relays in the network. The effect of relay number and locations were investigated by considering energy optimization. The proposed method is based on a network representation enabling to match each network configuration. The simulation-based performance analysis confirmed that the cooperative relaying scheme had an advantage of diversity gain thus improving the bit error ratio performance. The simulation results demonstrated that the proposed cooperative relay node selection algorithm could improve performances by achieving the cooperative gain.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technology of Urban Monitoring Video Dynamic Target Space Calibration Based on 3D Geographic Information System
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: Geographic information system is applied to urban video surveillance, in which video cameras are labeled and used as control points in video-based spatial surveying and mapping. Through coordinating, abstracting, semantization and vectorization, the original raw videos are transformed into a four-dimensional data set. Then, these videos are integrated and managed with a three-dimensional geographic information system. Based on this, functions such as conditional query, location searching and correlation analysis of dynamic objects in massive videos are implemented.

articleTitle: Mind the Gap: Understanding Gender Inequality in Movie Industry using Social Network Analysis and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: Gender inequality in the movie industry has increasingly received attention in recent times. This paper aims to understand gender inequality in the movie industry using social network analysis and machine learning by predicting whether a movie would pass the Bechdel Test. In particular, social network data constructed from movie subtitles to indicate the interactions between characters is used, in conjunction with the movie metadata to characterize each movie. Results from social network analysis showed that female actors generally occupy less important social positions and play a less important role in the social networks in almost all genres. This is even prevalent in Romance and Family movies that basic statistics find more female actors, suggesting that social network analysis provides non-obvious values using traditional methods. Moreover, the gradient boosting tree model can achieve 77.4% of accuracy to correctly classified a movie to be gender equitable or not, with the help of the graph features obtained from the movie social networks. This is 16% uplift compared to using only the movie metadata. Overall, social network analysis not only provides new findings of female actor's role in the movie, but also can greatly help machine learning model to achieve much better performance to predict the gender disparity in movies.

articleTitle: A study on the Dilemma and Countermeasures of Rural Teachers’ Information-based Teaching Ability in Guangxi
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: With the continuous development of educational reform and the rapid development of educational informatization, information-based teaching has been more and more popular and valued. Information equipment teaching in class has become a popular and necessary tool for teacher. Rural teachers are the leading factor in rural primary school, their teaching ability plays a very important role in educating rural teachers. So improving rural teacher's information-based teaching ability is of great important. However, the education situation of urban and rural is uneven, and the development of rural teachers' information-based teaching ability is restricted by various factors. This paper makes a detailed study on the present situation of rural teachers' information-based teaching in Guangxi, analyzes and probes into the training strategies of information-based teaching ability, which can further promote the development of rural teachers' information-based teaching ability.

articleTitle: Research on the Blended Teaching Model of "Analog Electronic Technology" Course in Institutions of higher learning Based on WeChat Platform
publicationTitle: 2019 International Conference on Information Technology and Computer Application (ITCA)
abstract: We analyzed the current teaching situation, existing problems and the necessity of developing a Blended teaching mode of "Analog Electronic Technology" course for electromechanical and educational technology majors in Institutions of higher learning. With the help of the functions of voice short message, video, picture and text supported by WeChat, we constructed a mixed teaching mode. In order to improve course teaching effect, the course processing are divided into three stage: Before class, some knowledge are introduced to students; during class, we use on-line and off-line method to demonstrate the knowledge in details; after class, on-line method is used to strengthened knowledge and capacity base.
